    • When a player dies, they lose 1 maximum heart (minimum one 1 heart can be had by a player).
    • Players deal reduced damage based on their current health (For example if you have full heart but then take damage to half Hp you'll deal reduced damage to enemies until you heal up).
    • Players can regain a maximum heart by consuming a saddle (Shift + Right Click on a saddle)

    • Rifts are portals that will randomly generate every 15 minutes if there is NOT already a rift in the world.
    • These portals have attributes listed above them (I.E. FAST, EXTRA HEALTH, EXTRA DAMAGE). Which would mean enemies in there are fast, have extra health, and deal extra damage.

    • At the end of a dungeon there is a Rift Boss (A wither in most cases) upon killing the Wither a message will be broadcasted saying the Rift is closing, after 60 seconds the portal in the outer world will be destroyed and drop a large sum of EXP, and items from a loot table depending on how hard the Rift was.   • Citadel

    • Citadel enables users to use minerals (Stone, Iron, and Diamonds) to reinforce blocks.
    • A Reinforced block (That you are not a group member of) requires to be broken 25, 250, 1800 times respectively to Stone, Iron, and Diamonds in order to be actually broken.
    • This plugins allows players to protect themselves from grief without Admin intervention, but also allows the "Raider" play style to still be a thing without being banned for it.
    • Users can protect doors/chests this will prevent other users not apart of their group from entering it, until they break it the respective amount of times.

  • Prison Pearl

    • PrisonPearl, allows players to trap other players in the end upon killing another player while having an EnderPearl in your HOTBAR.
    • The player will receive an enderpearl with the name of the player they killed, that player will then be trapped in the End until the other player releases them.
    • Enderpearls require coal to be fed to them when they are in a chest, so if you Pearl someone, then lock them in a chest and forget about them, they will be released.
